Package arcade.potts.agent.module

Class PottsModuleApoptosis

java.lang.Object
arcade.potts.agent.module.PottsModule
arcade.potts.agent.module.PottsModuleApoptosis
All Implemented Interfaces:
Module
Direct Known Subclasses:
PottsModuleApoptosisSimple
public abstract class PottsModuleApoptosis extends PottsModule
Extension of PottsModule for apoptosis.

During apoptosis, cells cycle through early and late phases. Once the cell completes the late phase, it is removed from the simulation.
